% fig6.tex -- Figure 6, v7 (binding spec ../DESIGN_V7.md; worked example ../fig1): ad vendors receive the landing URL,
% including a creator's per-video code, and the measurements behind it repeat across loads and agree with a screenshot
% audit.
% Layout (cells: panels/fig6_layout.tex, generated by scripts/make_fig6_panels.py, the one source), 190 x \FigH mm,
% 6 mm gutters, no outer margin:
%   row 1  a (hero, full width): Store C. Left, the code's path as a line drawing (fig6a_path.tex, TikZ, on Fig. 1a's
%          regions and grounds); right, the per-load counts (fig6a_loads.pdf). One letter: the plot cell is placed by
%          \PanelPart (below), which checks its size like \Panel but draws no letter.
%   row 2  b creator-linked stores | c full landing URL by vendor | d validation agreement.
% Every plot box (a's plot, b, c, d) has the same top and height, so the four boxes share one top line and one x-axis
% line per row. Panels are vector PDFs drawn at final size; \Panel checks each size and draws the 8 pt bold lowercase
% letters (no panel titles). The cells are asserted in scripts/make_fig6_panels.check_composite.
% Build: PATH=/opt/anaconda3/bin:$PATH zsh build_fig6.sh
\documentclass[tikz,border=0pt]{standalone}
\def\StyleDir{../style/}
\input{\StyleDir tikzstyle_v2.tex}
\providecommand{\PanelDir}{panels}
\input{\PanelDir/fig6_layout.tex}
% \PanelPart{x}{y}{w}{h}{file.pdf}: the second cell of a two-part panel (a's plot beside a's drawing). As \Panel --
% placed at 100 %, its size checked against the cell to 0.2 mm -- but without a letter (fig6-local; the shared style is
% not edited).
\newcommand{\PanelPart}[5]{%
  \figCheckInside{a (part)}{#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}%
  \sbox\figPanelBox{\includegraphics{#5}}%
  \figCheckDim{a (part)}{width}{\wd\figPanelBox}{#3}%
  \figCheckDim{a (part)}{height}{\dimexpr\ht\figPanelBox+\dp\figPanelBox\relax}{#4}%
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0pt, outer sep=0pt] at (#1,-#2) {\usebox\figPanelBox};}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \FigureCanvas{\FigH}
  %          letter  x          y          w         h          file
  \Panel     {a}     {0}        {0}        {\ADW}    {\AH}      {\PanelDir/fig6a_path.pdf}
  \PanelPart         {\APX}     {0}        {\APW}    {\AH}      {\PanelDir/fig6a_loads.pdf}
  \Panel     {b}     {0}        {\RowTwoY} {\BW}     {\RowTwoH} {\PanelDir/fig6b_creators.pdf}
  \Panel     {c}     {\CX}      {\RowTwoY} {\CW}     {\RowTwoH} {\PanelDir/fig6c_url.pdf}
  \Panel     {d}     {\DX}      {\RowTwoY} {\DW}     {\RowTwoH} {\PanelDir/fig6d_validation.pdf}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
